arms.A: AGES direct: opencode subprocess started by the runner
arms.B: AGES + ADK: the same opencode subprocess started inside a google-adk 2.12.0 BaseAgent (SequentialAgent via InMemoryRunner)

model_note: Exactly one free-tier model id, the same for both arms and all tasks. Paid APIs are not allowed. Fill it, verify that `opencode run` answers with it, commit this file BEFORE the first run.
agent_cmd_note: argv template; {model} and {prompt} are substituted verbatim. Check the real flags of the installed opencode before the first run and fix this line in the pre-registration commit. Arm A and arm B always use the identical argv.
acceptance: ab/tests/test_<task>.py game.html exits 0 and prints ACCEPTANCE_PASS (Playwright headless Chromium, three@0.160.0 served locally via THREE_DIR)
repeat_policy: No re-runs because of an unwanted result. A re-run is allowed only when the agent process failed to start (returncode None); keep both logs and mark the first as technical_failure.
verdict_policy: compare.py decides. Fewer than 3 valid pairs = INCONCLUSIVE. Quality (acceptance pass) before speed. Tokens are UNKNOWN unless observable.
valid_pair_conditions: same task, same model_id, same prompt_sha256, same cmdline
both arms started a real agent process (agent_pid set, returncode not None)
arm B has adk_events >= 1 (a real ADK run)
forbidden: editing tests after the first run
